jesus.name: Jesus of Nazareth
jesus.face: first-century Galilean Jewish man; warm olive-brown skin; dark brown eyes; strong but gentle features; kind, thoughtful expression
jesus.hair: dark brown, wavy, falling to the shoulders, parted naturally; short full dark beard
jesus.build: average height, lean and strong like a working carpenter, natural proportions
jesus.clothing: ankle-length undyed cream wool tunic with a plain woven belt; a deep russet-brown mantle draped over the left shoulder; simple leather sandals
jesus.notes: No halo or glow. Never looking directly at the viewer in story scenes. Same face, hair, beard and clothing in every chapter.
